name: The Design Edit: Godflow
description:
We’re trying something a little different with our next session of **The Design Edit** 👁️

This time, we’re making room for GodFlow — a local, design-forward fashion label whose work has piqued our interest.

Designers are some of the most interesting people in any room. Their references don’t always come from design. They come from music, cinema, books, cities, people and memories. Most of these things have nothing to do with design. And yet, somehow, they find their way into what we make.

So we thought — why not just put a bunch of designers in a room and see where the conversation goes? Important note - the sharpest argument gets a 20% knock off on Godflow collection.

We’ll talk about fashion, design, art, the things that move us, and the things we find ourselves arguing about. GodFlow will share the thinking behind **Chapter 02**, and we’ll spend some time with the collection too.

Mostly, it’s just a room to meet people, exchange thoughts, argue a little, laugh a little, and hopefully leave with a few new ideas.

**Date:** Friday, 2nd October 2026

**20 seats only**

name: Life Admin Deli
description:
*Emails you’ve been putting off, appointments you need to book, that return you still haven’t made, and the never-ending little list in your notes app.*

**This long weekend, we are introducing the Life Admin Deli — a dedicated morning to finally get your life together, one task at a time.**

Bring your laptop, to-do list, notebook, or simply everything you’ve been meaning to sort out. Settle into our sunlit studio café, and spend a few unhurried hours getting through the life admin that’s been quietly taking up space in your head.

And you won’t be doing it alone. The Life Admin Deli lets you get productive alongside others who are also getting their lives in order, *because everything feels a little easier when you do it together.*

Once the to-do list starts shrinking, take a break and **enjoy a delicious, nourishing brunch by Copper + Cloves.**

Good food, a fresh drink, a little conversation, and the satisfying feeling of having actually gotten things done!

description:
Yes, And Dragons is our improvised D&D-styled fantasy adventure where a party of unlikely heroes is thrown into a world of magic, danger, and shifting fate.

There are vampires and bards, elves and hags; alliances form, loyalties are tested, and somewhere along the way, stories of love, loss, and courage begin to take shape. A giant inflatable die, looms over it all, changing the course of the story with every roll.

Will our heroes prevail, or will the villains claim a victory? Only one way to find out.

**Who are Improv Lore?**

We are a Bangalore-based community-theatre troupe, working towards spreading the art of spontaneous storytelling & unscripted stagecraft, and rekindling the joy of being playful & whimsical. We meet on Wednesdays for Jams, and on weekends for workshops.

name: Hatha Yoga
description:
**About Jeevanam**

Nestled in the heart of Indiranagar - Bengaluru, our serene yoga and well-being space offers a haven where you can embark on a journey to nurture your mind, body, and beyond.

We curate a variety of Yoga classes designed to foster a deeper body-mind connection through various styles and techniques. Our classes cater to individuals of all age groups, professions, and health needs, providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for everyone.

**About Hatha Yoga with Props**

Yoga with props enhances practice by integrating various props like blocks, straps, Iyengar chairs, and bolsters. These sessions aim to deepen stretches, improve alignment, and cater to individual needs.

This style emphasizes holding poses for extended periods, enhancing strength, flexibility, and awareness. Encourages practitioners to explore the subtleties of each posture, fostering a deep connection between mind, body, and breath.

Props provide support, making poses accessible for all levels, fostering a more inclusive and personalized yoga experience.

(Please note Hatha Yoga with props is only available on Fridays)

name: Balance Within: Pilates for Hormonal Health
description:
**Wired but tired? Strong but not quite yourself?**

Your hormones are working behind the scenes every hour of every day — shaping your energy, your mood, your sleep, and how your body responds to stress. And when life is always-on, they take the hit. The good news: the right kind of movement can help bring them back into balance. In this focused one-hour session, you'll discover how Pilates works *with* your body's natural rhythms instead of against them. We'll start with a quick, eye-opening look at how stress and your cycle affect how you feel — then move into a guided practice that builds real core and glute strength while calming your nervous system and lowering cortisol. You'll finish with a slow, restorative close that leaves you grounded, clear-headed, and noticeably lighter.

You'll walk out with a body that feels different, a simple take-home routine, and a fresh understanding of how to move for hormonal health for years to come.

**Spaces are limited to keep it small and personal.**

description:
Presented by Bangalore Film Forum

Night of the Living Dead (1968)

By George A. Romero / 96' / English

A deceptively simple tale of a group of strangers trapped in a farmhouse who find themselves fending off a horde of recently dead, flesh-eating ghouls, Romero’s claustrophobic vision of a late-1960s America literally tearing itself apart rewrote the rules of the horror genre, combining gruesome gore with acute social commentary and quietly breaking ground by casting a Black actor (Duane Jones) in its lead role.

name: KishanBaalaji Collective presents a Tribute to Ariana Grande and Billie Eilish
description:
**About the Event:**

KishanBaalaji Collective is throwing a full tribute night for two women who have been living rent-free in our heads, our playlists and our personalities for years. We're talking Ariana Grande, who made ponytails a power move and turned "thank u, next" into a life philosophy. And Billie Eilish, who somehow makes looking effortless look like an art form and writes songs that make you feel like the main character every single time.

Ten songs each. Twenty reasons to show up looking your absolute best.

**KishanBaalaji Collective** has been doing this for a while now — taking the music of icons like Pink Floyd, Dua Lipa, Kylie Minogue, and Girish and the Chronicles and making them feel brand new on a live stage. This October, they're turning that same electric energy toward pop's most beloved — and The Humming Tree is going to feel very, very good that night.

**The Humming Tree:**

The Humming Tree - A grassroots performance venue in Bangalore, running from 2013 to 2019 and in the process becoming a cornerstone of Bangalore’s independent music, art, and cultural ecosystem.

Now, in 2026, The Humming Tree is back in a brand-new, purpose-designed space in Indiranagar. Built across 12,000 sq. ft., the venue features a 600+ capacity performance space, world-class sound and lighting systems, and a diverse F&B proposition. More than just a venue, it’s a hub for creativity, culture and collaboration.

name: Exploring Anthotypes: Printing with the Sun
description:
Come explore the fascinating world of anthotypes—an early photographic process that uses plant-based pigments and sunlight to create images.

In this hands-on workshop, you’ll experiment with pigments extracted from flowers, spinach, beetroot, and turmeric, and discover how colour, light, and time can come together to make an image. You’ll create your own compositions, test out different natural materials, and see how sunlight gradually transforms them.

The workshop brings together simple chemistry, photographic processes, and creative expression, offering a chance to slow down and discover what happens when you let nature become part of the image-making process.

No prior experience is needed, only a willingness to experiment!

All materials will be provided.

name: A Founders' Room: GodFlow at General Items
description:
Founding is one of the loneliest jobs there is.

Your friends don't fully get it. Your family worries constantly and the thing keeping you up at 3 AM is almost impossible to explain to anyone who hasn't been there. So most founders stop explaining and carry it alone.

**So here's what this is:**

**GodFlow** and **General Items** have partnered to host an event for **founders only**. **Twenty founders** across fields and stages, in one room, for **90 minutes on a Sunday morning**.

You'll be put into **teams** and take on some of the **hottest debates in entrepreneurship** — the arguments founders have online, settled in person instead. Between rounds: **real stories, real problems, and ideas that don't fit in a comment section**.

Every seat also comes with **access to a GodFlow piece made with founders in mind** — one of **only 60**, designed around the **founder's journey**, and available **offline only**.

**Who it's for**

**Founders.** Early stage, mid build, first company or third. **Product, fashion, tech, services, agencies**, anyone who has **put their name on something** and is responsible for keeping it alive.

So we're putting **twenty founders in one room**.

**What you leave with**

- **Perspectives and ideas** you didn't walk in with
- **Exclusive offers** across the collection
- A **community of fellow entrepreneurs**, not a contact list

**What happens**

- **Fast intros:** who you are, what you're building, and why.
- **The GodFlow story:** the vision and thinking behind **Chapter 02**, and what building it actually cost.
- **The Switch:** a **team debate** on the hot takes founders argue about online. Halfway through, you **argue the opposite side**.
- **A piece made offline only**, designed around the **founder's journey**. Not sold anywhere else.
- **A room worth meeting**, not a pitch round.

**Rs 500.** Your ticket is **redeemable** against the collection or the store. The team with the **sharpest argument gets 20% off**.

**Twenty entrepreneurs.** **One Sunday morning. Good drinks, and conversations that stick.**

name: Ehsaas
description:
Ehsaas: come walk through Ajji Mane at The Commons with us

📅 10 October | 📍 The Commons, Bangalore

Ehsaas is Urdu for feeling, for realisation. And we'd love for you to come feel it with us.

Why we're doing this

The desi household look was never a style. It was just how our homes looked, growing up. Then it got called dated, then gaudy, and now everyone is chasing it again. We didn't want to explain it to you. We wanted to invite you back inside it.

The Commons shape-shifts around whatever idea it's holding. This time, the foundation was already here: Ajji Mane, Ajji House itself. So we curated it into an experience you can simply walk into, and know what The Commons truly means.

What you'll experience

Ehsaas is a sensorial walkthrough of an ajji's house, room by room. Every room carries its own smell, built into the space itself. A look at the zones:

Sparsh (touch): Start in the tulsi courtyard. Sit with a potter and shape your own matka, guided from start to finish, with clay on your hands.

Awaaz (sound): Sit a while. Listen to nostalgic audios, the jingles, the suprabhatam in the background, the quiet-loud of a house full of people.

Zaika (taste), curated by Subko: Kaccha mango, pickles laid out for tasting, hot chips in crinkly packets, steel plates, a striped cloth hand towel.

Nazar (sight): Step into a living room pulled straight from your grandmother's house.

And at the end, the memory wall, so you can write down everything the space brought back.

**Your ticket includes Pottery Workshop, Sensorial Experience and F&B**

Entry to the full Ehsaas walkthrough, all zones

The Sparsh pottery workshop, guided by a potter, and the piece to take back home

The Zaika food spread, curated by Subko

Bring your friends, bring your family, bring whoever you'd want next to you in an ajji's living room. We'd love to have you all.

name: ALLFORM COMBINE 002
description:
At the Allform Combine, athletes compete on more than just endurance.

The Combine is built around the five pillars of athleticism — **speed, agility, power, strength, and endurance — tested through nine standardised events.** Every performance contributes to a single Allform Athlete Score, creating one benchmark for the complete athlete.

At the end of the Combine, every athlete receives a Stat Card — numbers behind their performance, from individual event results to their overall score. This is not a race. Each score is taken independently, with rest between attempts.

Your first Combine gives you a benchmark to beat at the next combine.

Win different. Be an Allform Athlete.

name: What Remains: Sound & Watercolour experience
description:
What happens when you stop trying to create something perfect and simply create from what you feel?

What Remains is a 90-minute immersive experience bringing together sound healing, stillness and intuitive watercolour painting.

Guided by Sound With Sri, the experience begins by slowing down and tuning inward through sound. From that space of stillness, you’ll move into intuitive watercolour — allowing colour, movement and emotion to take shape on paper.

There’s no right way to paint, and no artistic experience is needed. This isn’t an art class. It’s an invitation to listen, pause, feel and create. 🤍

🎨 All materials provided

✨ No prior art or sound healing experience required

Come as you are. Leave with something that reflects what remained.

name: Kombucha Tasting for Nerds
description:
Not a cafe, not a bar, not a restaurant. Mountain Bee Kombucha is a brewery by the day, a cosy R&D bar by the evening pouring signature kombucha and crafting in-house zero-proof cocktails. Come for drinks, music and calm atmosphere surrounded by people who would love to make you feel home and show-off their newest creations.

Our tasting room is an intimate 8-seater space created for sharing good drink and company.

Tasting hours: Monday to Saturday evening from 6-7 pm.

Please note:

Booking fee (₹999) covers upto 4 drinks and snacks. Any purchases made will be charged separately. Reservations are for 1 hour slot, please reach the venue 10 minutes early. We'll give you a heads-up as your time winds down. Seating is communal, expect to share the table, and maybe a conversation or two, with other guests. We accept UPI for additional purchases, no card.

All bookings are final. Rescheduling is possible with at least 48 hours' notice, one reschedule per booking. No-shows and late cancellations aren't refundable. You'll need to be curious, not necessarily 21, this is alcohol-free, all ages welcome.

What's not included

- any purchases made at the venue apart from whats included in the experience

name: Mama T's Table Thanksgiving Edition
description:
**About the Event:**

Join us at Mama T’s Table for a Canadian Thanksgiving dinner by Chef Tori Macdonald, bringing together flavours inspired by her Canadian roots. Settle in and enjoy a sit-down dinner full of friends both old and new, comforting flavours and a whole lot of laughs. The evening includes a buffet dinner featuring a selection of vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes.

The menu for the evening is shared below so you can get a little taste of what’s in store.

**About the Chef:**

Tori Macdonald is a chef who feeds both the stomach and the spirit. Though Canadian by birth, she has called Bangalore home for over twelve years, and the city’s warmth now runs through her cooking as much as her own family roots. Her love affair with the kitchen began at age four, standing beside her mom, grandmas, and great-grandma, who encouraged her to turn passion into profession. Known for food that is simple, soulful, and deeply comforting, Tori believes the kitchen is the true heart of a home. After five years at The Humming Tree, she now brings that philosophy to Slurp Culinary Academy, where she teaches students to find the story, and the soul, behind every plate.

**The Humming Tree:**

The Humming Tree - A grassroots performance venue in Bangalore, running from 2013 to 2019 and in the process becoming a cornerstone of Bangalore’s independent music, art, and cultural ecosystem.

Now, in 2026, The Humming Tree is back in a brand-new, purpose-designed space in Indiranagar. Built across 12,000 sq. ft., the venue features a 600+ capacity performance space, world-class sound and lighting systems, and a diverse F&B proposition. More than just a venue, it’s a hub for creativity, culture and collaboration.

name: Dakshin Diaries by The Counterpoint Crew
description:
Dakshin Diaries by The Counterpoint Crew brings a fresh, contemporary choral experience to the proscenium stage. Featuring 20 voices delivering live amplified stage harmony, this concert explores distinct musical worlds without creative boundaries.

The performance showcases a brand-new repertoire spanning classical polyphony, soulful regional folk, and iconic melodies reimagined across Kannada, Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam, Telugu, and English. Audiences will experience rich vocal arrangements alongside independent music. Every piece is thoughtfully arranged to celebrate the expressive versatility and dynamic resonance of the human voice.

Designed as an immersive, seated auditorium showcase, the evening offers music lovers a rare opportunity to hear diverse genres unified through rich, multi-part choral textures. Whether you are a dedicated choral enthusiast, an indie music follower, or simply seeking an evocative musical evening, take your seat and let the harmony surround you.
